title: Categories, brands and size charts
subtitle: The lists every product is sorted by.

common.loadFailed: This list could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
common.slugHint: Optional. Leave empty to make it from the English name.
common.isActiveHint: Inactive items stay in the system but are hidden from the shop.

categories.dialogDescription: Categories group products in the shop menu and in reports.
categories.sortOrderHint: A smaller number comes first. The arrows in the list change it too.
categories.emptyDescription: Add the first category, for example Clothing, then add sub-categories under it.
categories.deleteDescription: "{name}" will be removed. A category that still has products or sub-categories cannot be deleted: deactivate it instead.

brands.deleteDescription: "{name}" will be removed. A brand that products still use cannot be deleted: deactivate it instead.

sizeCharts.dialogDescription: Customers see this table on the product page as the size guide.
sizeCharts.summary: {columns, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}} x {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
sizeCharts.emptyDescription: Add a chart such as Clothing sizes so customers can pick the right size.

grid.label: Size table
grid.hint: The first row holds the column titles. Every row needs a value in every column.
grid.needColumn: The table needs at least one column.
grid.cellRequired: Fill every cell (a dash is fine for none).

importExport.title: Import products
importExport.description: Upload a CSV or Excel file: one row per variant. Images are added per product afterwards and imported products start as drafts.
importExport.fileHint: Up to 5 MB and 5,000 rows. Download the template to see the columns.
importExport.mode: What should happen to products that already exist?
importExport.modeCreateHint: A product whose slug already exists is reported as an error.
importExport.modeUpsertHint: An empty cell keeps the current value. To clear a value, edit the product in the admin.
importExport.checkOk: The file is fine. Nothing has been saved yet: choose Import now to save it.
importExport.checkErrors: The file has errors. Nothing was saved. Fix the rows below in your file and check it again.
importExport.rejected: The file was rejected. Nothing was saved.
importExport.refused: The file could not be used.
importExport.issuesTruncated: Only the first problems are listed. Fix them and check again to see the rest.
